notes.zh-CN: 新增小米语音遥控：把已配对的遥控器连上电脑，麦克风语音即可转成文字输入，按钮可控制 GrokX；设置页新增「语音遥控」分区。侧边栏支持多选会话批量删除。macOS 为 universal 开发签名、未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队已注册设备。
notes.en: New Xiaomi voice remote: connect a paired remote to your computer, dictate with its microphone as text input, and control GrokX with its buttons. A new "Voice remote" section is added to Settings. The sidebar now supports multi-select batch deletion of sessions. macOS is universal and development-signed, not notarized; Windows installers are unsigned; APK is debug-signed; IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only.
